title: 第1019章 炎骨觉醒第1018章 魔尊惊魂
lines: 幽冥神域之内，空气仿佛凝固成了沉重的铅块。
三位魔尊的决死一击，如同三颗毁灭的星辰，
撕裂了神域的压制，带着令天地失色的恐怖威能，悍然轰向领域中心的林烬！
骨狱魔尊的骸骨神钻，燃烧着破灭万物的魔焰，
尖端凝聚着足以洞穿小世界的恐怖穿透力！
幽影魔尊的暗蚀尖锥，无声无息，却散发着蚀灭空间、消融法则的阴毒气息！
噬魂魔尊的怨魂之刺，凝聚了亿万怨魂的绝望哀嚎，
直指灵魂本源，足以让帝境神魂重创！
三道攻击，尚未及体，那恐怖的威压已经让林烬的幽冥神域剧烈震荡，
七尊熔炉发出不堪重负的哀鸣，炉壁上的符文疯狂闪烁，仿佛随时都会崩碎！
林烬的皮肤在威压下寸寸开裂，金色的血液渗出，又被瞬间蒸腾成血雾！
识海之中，那道冰冷的灰色气流疯狂蠕动，发出尖锐的警告！
“挡不住！绝对挡不住！”
死亡的阴影从未如此清晰！
林烬的瞳孔因极致的压力而收缩成针尖大小，
赤金色的神光在瞳孔深处疯狂燃烧，如同即将熄灭的烛火在做最后的挣扎。
他体内的焚荒神力在三位魔尊半步帝境的威压下，
如同被冻结的河流，运转迟滞到了极点！
幽冥神域的吞噬之力，在这三道超越极限的攻击面前，显得杯水车薪！
“要死了吗？不！我不能死！遗落之城的子民还在等我！
风啸还在等我！还有…他们还在等我去寻找！！”
强烈的不甘与守护的执念，如同最后的薪柴，点燃了林烬灵魂深处最本源的力量！
就在那三道毁灭攻击即将将他彻底湮灭的千钧一发之际——
林烬体内，仿佛有什么东西…破碎了！
不是肉身，不是骨骼，而是某种更深层次、源自血脉源头的桎梏！
一股难以言喻的、古老而尊贵的意志，如同沉睡的太古巨龙，轰然苏醒！
并非来自外界，而是源自林烬自身！
他的丹田气海深处，那七尊承受着巨大压力的地狱熔炉核心，
猛地爆发出前所未有的炽烈神光！
炉壁上，那些原本模糊的山川河流、日月星辰、幽冥生灵的符文，
在这一刻彻底清晰、活了过来！
尤其是其中一道烙印在熔炉核心深处、
由九道扭曲的、仿佛连接着九重地狱的骨纹印记，骤然点亮！
一声仿佛来自九幽最底层、穿越了无尽时空的龙吟，从林烬体内爆发！
content_en:
Within the Netherworld Divine Realm, the air seemed to solidify into a heavy lead.
The decisive blows of the three Demon Lords were like three destroyed stars,
It tore apart the suppression of the divine domain, and with a terrifying power that eclipsed the world, it blasted towards Lin Jin in the center of the domain!
The Bone Divine Diamond of the Bone Hell Demon Lord burns with the demonic flame that destroys all things.
The tip contains terrifying penetrating power that can penetrate the small world!
The dark corroding cone of the Shadow Demon Lord is silent, but it exudes the vicious aura of eroding space and dissolving the law!
The Soul-Eating Demon Lord's resentful soul thorn embodies the desperate wails of billions of resentful souls.
Directly pointing at the origin of the soul is enough to severely damage the soul of the Emperor Realm!
The three attacks had not yet reached his body, but the terrifying pressure had already caused Lin Jin's Netherworld Divine Realm to shake violently.
The seven furnaces let out overwhelmed whines, and the runes on the furnace walls flashed crazily, as if they would collapse at any time!
Lin Jin's skin cracked under the pressure, golden blood seeped out, and was instantly evaporated into blood mist!
In the sea of ​​consciousness, the cold gray air flow crazily squirmed, issuing a sharp warning!
"Can't stop it! Absolutely can't stop it!"
The shadow of death has never been so clear!
Lin Jin's pupils shrank to the size of a pinhead due to the extreme pressure.
The red-gold divine light burned crazily in the depths of his pupils, like an extinguished candle making its final struggle.
The burning divine power in his body was under the pressure of the three demon lords who were half-step into the imperial realm.
Like a frozen river, its movement is extremely sluggish!
The devouring power of the Netherworld God Realm seems to be a drop in the bucket in the face of these three attacks that exceed the limit!
"Are you going to die? No! I can't die! The people of the Forgotten City are still waiting for me!
Feng Xiao is still waiting for me! And...they're still waiting for me to find them! ! "
The strong unwillingness and obsession to protect were like the last firewood, igniting the most original power deep in Lin Jin's soul!
At the critical moment when those three destructive attacks were about to completely annihilate him——
“Buzz——!!!”
There seemed to be something... broken inside Lin Jin's body!
Not the physical body, not the bones, but some deeper shackles originating from the source of blood!
An indescribable, ancient and noble will, like a sleeping ancient dragon, suddenly awakens!
"Boom——!!!"
Not from the outside world, but from Lin Jin himself!
Deep in the sea of ​​Qi in his Dantian, the seven hell furnace cores are under tremendous pressure.
An unprecedented blazing divine light suddenly burst out!
On the hearth wall, those originally vague runes of mountains, rivers, sun, moon, stars, and ghostly creatures,
Completely clear and alive in this moment!
Especially one of the imprints deep in the core of the furnace,
Nine twisted bone marks that seemed to connect the nine hells suddenly lit up!
"Roar——!!!"
A dragon roar that seemed to come from the lowest level of Jiuyou and traveled through endless time and space erupted from Lin Jin's body!
title_en: Chapter 1019: The Awakening of Flame Bones Chapter 1018: The Demon Lord’s Shock
